habitat: Lowland and montane forests; primary/well-aged secondary growth; mid-storey of rainforests
story: Few birds capture the imagination quite like the Penan Bulbul (Alophoixus ruficrissus). As a member of the Pycnonotidae family, it has carved out a unique niche in Lowland and montane forests; primary/well-aged secondary growth; mid-storey of rainforests. Its conservation status is Least Concern (LC), a classification that drives crucial research and protection efforts. The Penan Bulbul's presence is a vital sign of its ecosystem's health, making its preservation a priority. This poster is a tribute to the Penan Bulbul, celebrating its role in the natural world and inspiring a deeper appreciation for biodiversity.
